name: Advanced Nano Products Co., Ltd.
summary: Advanced Nano Products Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing materials used in thin-film solar cells, display panels, and semiconductor CMP processes in South Korea and internationally. It offers conductive material slurry batter materials; hollow silica; printing electronics, such as inkjet metal ink, silver paste, and silver nanowire; ceria slurry semiconductor materials; anti reflectance coating solution, anti-static coating solution, transparent conductive oxide, insulation coating solution functional coating material products; and sputtering target products. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Sejong, South Korea.
